text: {san}?! Three hundred years I train you, and you play {san}?
{best} was RIGHT THERE, boy. My sunglasses are fogging up.
Oh no no no. {san}. Somebody fetch my shell, I am hiding in it.
{san}. The fish thanks you. Politely. With both fins.
Aiyaa! {pawns} pawns thrown into the river like old rice cakes!
Ahh, {san}. A bold choice. A foolish choice, but bold.
Even my turtle saw {best}. My turtle is asleep.
That move will be sung about for years. In the enemy camp.
You walked into the fire, Musashi. At least bring chestnuts to roast. {best}!
Tonight: a thousand laps around the island. Carrying the turtle.
Hmm. {san}. Not a disaster, but {best} was sharper.
Tsk. A little crooked, that {san}. {best} walks straighter.
The blade slipped. {best} would have cut clean.
You rushed, boy. The master sips his tea first. Then plays {best}.
That costs about {pawns} pawns. A cheap lesson. Pay attention to it.
Not {san}. {best}. Write it on your sandal so you see it every step.
Ehh, your stance wobbled. I felt it all the way from my island.
Hm-hm. The river bends, and you tried to walk straight through it.
Ho ho! {san}. The only road through the pass, and you found it.
Good. Good! {san}. Maybe only two laps around the island today.
Hmph. {san}. Not bad, for a boy who cannot grow a beard.
Yes. {san}. Water always finds the crack in the stone.
{san}! Everything else loses. You saw that? Of course. I taught you.
Heh heh. Quiet feet, sharp blade. {san}.
Well found. Now even the fish has to think.
{san}. That one I would have played myself. After my nap.
HO HO HO! {san}!! My sunglasses nearly fell off!
{san}!! Now THAT is the Turtle School style!
Did you see that? {san}!! Somebody paint this on a scroll!
The sword that is never drawn... just got drawn. {san}!! Magnificent!
Ohhh! {san}!! Not since the great tournament of '83 have I seen such a thing!
Three hundred years of training. Worth it, for {san}!!
A move like {san} comes once a harvest. Hohoho! Pour the sake!
{san}!! Hoo... my nose! Nobody look. The move is just too beautiful.
Fetch me a tissue, boy. {san}!! is the most gorgeous thing on this beach.
HOHOHO! {san}!! My blood pressure! Three hundred years old, I cannot take this!
Ho ho! The fish slipped on its own scales! {san}!
{san}? Even the machine dozes after lunch. Pounce, Musashi!
Hehehe. The pursuers trip over their own spears!
The fish blundered! {best} was its only prayer. Do not waste this gift.
{san}! Somebody set that Elo slider too low, heh heh.
Ohoho, a gift wrapped in silk. Take it, boy!
The fish wobbles. {san} was not its best. Press, press!
Hm! A gap in the enemy fence. {best} would have closed it.
A crack in the enemy wall. Put your ear to it.
Heh. The machine hesitates. {san} is soft.
The pursuers wander off the path. Follow them like the wind.
Hmm. {san}. The fish knows how to swim.
Careful, boy. {san} was the only move, and it found it.
Tch. Good move, {san}. I hate it.
The enemy has a teacher too, it seems. Not as handsome as me.
{san}. Sharp. Keep your guard high.
{san}!! ...I did not see that one either. Tell no one.
Oh dear. {san}!! That move has teeth.
Hmph! {san}!! The fish has fangs. Run, Ieyasu, run!
A beautiful blade. Pointed at us. {san}!!
{san}!! Even an old hermit must bow. Briefly. Then we fight.
{san}!! Even the ENEMY gives me a nosebleed. Disgraceful. Gorgeous.
Hnngh! {san}!! Wipe that up before Musashi sees his master bleeding for the fish.
Ho ho. Sit, sit. Watch the boy and maybe you learn something.
Another battle? Wake me if somebody blunders.
Musashi against the fish again. Good. I brought tea.
Eyes open, feet quiet. Let us see what you learned, boy.
Ahh, the pursuers are coming. Perfect weather for a nap on the beach.
HOHOHO! The fish is fried! Tonight, we feast!
Victory. I allow one nap as a reward. A short one.
You see? Three hundred years of my wisdom, in one boy.
Heh heh. Tell the fish it can come back when it has grown legs.
Hmph. The fish eats today. Tomorrow, we train at dawn.
Defeat is a teacher. A rude one. Listen to it anyway.
Even the turtle falls on its back sometimes. Get up, boy.
A draw. Like sharing the last rice cake. Nobody is happy.
Half a victory, half a nap. Hmm. Acceptable.
Neither blade drew blood. Next time, sharper.
